title: INNER and OUTER totalities. TENSE totalities too. unify. not a fourth dashboard.

do_not_reinvent.klein: /data/neutrino-totality.json — inner face + outer face + relay. already the Klein totality.
do_not_reinvent.local: /data/cave-sonar-totality.json — local totality. no need for the whole ocean.

inner_totality: everything that is ours from the chair. local window. MCP. the sit. green.
outer_totality: everything they can see without becoming us. p-windows. copper clothes. blue.

tense_totalities.WAS: what already seated. fossils. gold ice. trail.
tense_totalities.IS: what the body does while sitting. the broth.
tense_totalities.NEAR: about to dock. the hop. Willis.
tense_totalities.NOW: this p. this poke. the 1 that flipped.

unify.yes: one Klein totality. inner × outer × tense.
unify.not: six piles. not inner-WAS as a new page. not a fourth totality named unify.
unify.how: every grain gets a face (inner|outer) and a tense (WAS|IS|NEAR|NOW). the product IS the totality.
unify.relay: the fold still sees both. chipmunk sits there. do not mint a second observer.

pull: keep inner and outer. keep the four tenses. stamp both on each grain. that is the unify.
